data.title: AEON
data.about:
Explore the essence of waterfront living at Aeon in Dubai Creek Harbour, a development by the renowned Emaar Properties. Discover premium 1 to 3 bedroom apartments that seamlessly blend modern urban living with the timeless charm of Dubai Creek. 

Awaken to breathtaking skies and picturesque water views as Aeon at Dubai Creek Harbour transforms into a vibrant community for living, working, leisure, and unforgettable moments. Immerse yourself in the natural paradise along historic Dubai Creek, where the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is home to tens of thousands of birds in their natural habitat, adding a unique touch to the community. 

Your dream home awaits among modern properties that epitomize design excellence. Architectural elements and textures harmonize with a soft color palette, elevating the surroundings and creating a modern luxury ambiance at Aeon by Emaar Properties. The eclectic interiors set the stage for your private urban retreat.

location_tile.title: Reside Convieniently in AEON at Dubai Creek Harbour
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Aeon by Emaar at Dubai Creek Harbour benefits from an advanced and seamlessly integrated transportation network. This includes an extensive road infrastructure, a comprehensive bus network, proximity to four metro stations, convenient water taxis to Downtown Dubai, and a well-placed interchange. The neighborhood is designed with pedestrian-friendly streets, connecting the central hub to open spaces, creating a chic destination filled with a dynamic blend of shopping, business, leisure, and community amenities.

  • 10 Minutes – Dubai International Airport
  • 15 Minutes – Burj Khalifa
  • 40 Minutes – Al Maktoum International Airport
